d: We're looking for a Category Manager to spearhead and grow talabat's new standalone Beauty vertical. This is a high-impact, entrepreneurial role where you will define the category strategy from the ground up — owning assortment, supplier relationships, pricing, promotions, and commercial performance for beauty across the region.The right candidate brings deep knowledge of the beauty industry (skincare, haircare, cosmetics, fragrance, personal care), a strong commercial mindset, and the drive to build something new in one of the fastest-growing e-commerce markets in the world.
Lead end-to-end category management for the Beauty vertical, including skincare, cosmetics, haircare, fragrance, and personal care.
Define and execute the beauty category strategy aligned with talabat's commercial goals and regional consumer trends.
Monitor and drive category KPIs: sales, gross margin, P&L, conversion, and basket size.
Curate a compelling and competitive beauty assortment — balancing mass-market, premium, and emerging brands relevant to MENA consumers.
Identify and onboard local and regional beauty suppliers and brand partners; negotiate commercial terms including pricing, rebates, payment terms, and exclusivities.
Work closely with regional teams to align on international brand contracts and ensure a consistent portfolio across markets.
Stay ahead of beauty trends (clean beauty, K-beauty, halal-certified, etc.) and translate them into actionable assortment decisions.
Define pricing strategy for the beauty category in line with market benchmarks and competitor positioning.
Conduct regular market price audits across key beauty players in the region.
Build and manage the beauty promotions calendar — including seasonal campaigns (Ramadan, gifting seasons, beauty events) and brand-specific activations.
Analyze promotional effectiveness and continuously optimize based on consumer data and sell-through performance.
Provide input to the Operations team on store flow, product adjacencies, fixtures, and merchandising standards suited to beauty.
Partner with Marketing to develop compelling beauty campaigns and content that drive awareness and conversion.
Work with Replenishment on forecasting and inventory management to minimize out-of-stocks and overstock for high-SKU beauty ranges.
q: 3+ years of experience in category management, buying, or commercial roles within the beauty industry — ideally covering skincare, cosmetics, haircare, or fragrance.
Experience working with or for beauty retailers, beauty e-commerce platforms, FMCG companies, or beauty brand distributors in an international or regional setting.
Strong knowledge of the MENA beauty market: consumer preferences, key brands, distribution dynamics, and emerging trends.
Solid commercial acumen: proficiency in margin calculations, P&L management, promotional ROI analysis, and supplier negotiations.
Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable with ambiguity and excited to build a new vertical from scratch.
Highly detail-oriented and structured; able to manage multiple brands and SKUs while keeping the big picture in focus.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across both internal teams and external partners.
x: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

d: Mahally is a Saudi e-commerce marketplace by Salla that brings thousands of local stores together in one app, offering customers a wide range of products across fashion, beauty, electronics, home and more.

We are looking for a Marketing Communications Manager to lead Mahally's creative and social media direction. The role is responsible for creating campaign ideas and seasonal moments on social media, producing video content, and managing our work with influencers, UGC creators and creative agencies.
The Marketing Communications Manager works closely with the social media, design, performance marketing and category teams.
q: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Advertising, Communications, Graphic Design , or a related field.
Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in creative, content, social media, or related functions.
Minimum 3 years of experience in a senior, lead, or managerial role , with demonstrated ownership of creative strategy, content development, campaigns, or creative teams.
Strong portfolio demonstrating successful social media campaigns and video-first content , from concept development through execution.
Proven experience managing or collaborating with influencers, UGC creators, creative partners, and production agencies , preferably within the Saudi market.

Strong understanding of Saudi culture, consumer behaviour, digital trends, and the local social media landscape , with the ability to translate cultural insights into relevant and engaging creative content.
Hands-on experience across the video production lifecycle , including concept development, scripting/storyboarding, production, and post-production.
Professional proficiency in Arabic and English , with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong project and stakeholder management skills , with demonstrated ability to manage multiple campaigns, creative deliverables, agencies, and deadlines simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Previous experience within a creative, advertising, digital, or social media agency .
Strong Arabic copywriting and content development skills, particularly for Saudi audiences and social platforms.
Working proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma , with the ability to review, develop, or provide direction on creative assets.
Hands-on experience using AI-powered image and video tools for creative ideation, content development, production, or optimization.
